brief.title: Election update: Tuesday, November 24 (morning)
brief.markdown:
# Election update: Tuesday, November 24 (morning)

## Bottom line
**The tracker now counts House races on AP's calls.** That puts the House at 431 of 435 races called: D 258, R 173, matching AP's count of 258 to 173 with four races undecided ([Fox News](https://www.foxnews.com/politics/democrats-clinch-historic-house-majority-chuck-hubbard-defeats-longtime-gop-rep-virginia-foxx)). Earlier updates used the Wikipedia results table, which overcounted Democrats in two ways:
- It counted the two Louisiana runoff seats as wins.
- Its editors marked TN-04 and MN-01 as won before AP called them.

The four undecided races are TN-04, MN-01, and the Louisiana runoffs (LA-05 and LA-06) on Dec. 12. Democrats lead or were certified ahead in TN-04 and MN-01 ([House table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_House_of_Representatives_elections)). CBS News counts 47 House seats flipped by Democrats ([CBS News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxPdURNLUYxNXFnZWE2ektfNDRBQ09WcUltaVIxNnNWLXo0bDgxOHFNb0FkdmFXTElESUFKRHFUa2lMX1AtZVFwVGNUa2pNdU1pQTMzXzF1dVhXM2hVdXdjdUF5dllnZ1FZbXl0M3FLNThDaWFaTmx4OXdhUXREUXFHbGVR?oc=5)).

Every Senate race is called: D 56, R 44, counting seats not up ([Senate table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_Senate_elections)). Governorships are final at D 30, R 20 of 50, counting the 14 states with no race this year, with six flips, all to Democrats ([governor table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_gubernatorial_elections)).

## Called since the last update
- None. No race moved from uncalled to called on AP's count since Monday's update.

## Still uncalled
- **HOU-MN-01** (Lean R): the state certified Jake Johnson (D) ahead of Rep. Brad Finstad (R) by 324 votes, and the results table now marks Johnson as the winner. AP has not called the race. A hand recount is set, WXOW reports ([WXOW](https://news.google.?oc=5)), and FOX 9 reports Minnesota's recounts began Monday ([FOX 9](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilAFBVV95cUxQZWhIMUprR2I2S3FGd0trNERTcTRBTmVFR3RtcXprZ2xSR243MmJrcDFEdGQzY1RKYXMtRWxWZm1zaGhlQzNVTktIWEZaOXB5RjBWZWxjYUVRNnAwTE42WlRocGlhVThZTHcwWjg5R1hxNDBadzEtSTBTbDYtclpKR3JLUGF2TGhrWGFab1JPcm1Hd2s2?oc=5)).
- **HOU-TN-04** (unrated): Rep. Scott DesJarlais (R) conceded to Victoria Broderick (D) on Nov. 16 after provisional ballots put her ahead by about 280 votes ([Tennessee Lookout](https://tennesseelookout.com/2026/11/16/desjarlais-concedes-tennessee-4th-congressional-district-to-democrat-victoria-broderick/)). The results table marks Broderick as the winner, but AP's tally still lists the race as undecided ([Fox News](https://www.foxnews.com/politics/democrats-clinch-historic-house-majority-chuck-hubbard-defeats-longtime-gop-rep-virginia-foxx)).
- **HOU-LA-05** (unrated): runoff Dec. 12 between Pat Moore (D) and Gabe Firment (R) ([WWNO](https://www.wwno.org/2026-11-03/state-reps-pat-moore-gabe-firment-advance-to-5th-district-runoff)). Early voting begins this week, KALB reports ([KALB](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxPZ1BrQkROa3pKUy1ZMXJqLVpjNXhZNHRnMFVFXzFuSFVIVXY4ZHpjaUtkd1BXcTd4U1c2c1NxYlRlcUhNZFB2UTRQcUtqekkyT1d4cXdTRE44aFdnZWN5UUZQb21lanBzM09nV25TU3ZpZHpuQXp5VVBIc2Rub3hYUFZ3SlE?oc=5)).
- **HOU-LA-06** (unrated): runoff Dec. 12 between Chauna Banks (D) and Blake Miguez (R) ([WAFB](https://www.wafb.com/2026/11/04/chauna-banks-blake-miguez-advance-runoff-louisianas-6th-congressional-district/)).

## Recounts and certification
- **Alaska:** the state certified the midterm election, starting the clock for challenges and recounts, Alaska Public Media reports ([Alaska Public Media](https://news.google.?oc=5)). The Division of Elections' final report, timestamped Nov. 23, 10:54 a.m. Alaska time, added 158 votes. Peltola holds 50.14% of first-choice votes, a 12,561-vote lead ([state report](https://www.elections.alaska.gov/enr/26GENR/results/ElectionSummaryReportRPT.pdf)).
- **Certification elsewhere:** Arizona ([Arizona Mirror](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxQNmw0eE5RTlJhQzBQYXlLMGN2Ym9raVEwaXBINUNoSVpYWUhtZFJteUlWcERtR21XOTFyQ3pKRDZsM3R2alhpdmlhbmRmb3RJQkE0R0FJNGVvMzFaRmwtTTJHMWtETmpicnF1bWtyOXRhb3ZWc1FhWEV2SFlrQ2pqelpwZ0ozTGNpWFZKaA?oc=5)) and Michigan ([MLive](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxOT045YVlYZzdQVU5BWmxzV0JFZFpZNHBVR3ZEZmpORjhCbF9uWVlPRmlIRzlrTk5DQjhOd2Y1TDJOOU1TN1MzVnZCNTJ4ZktMTUloVTFqbkdMV0I0aFZHUE9LNW91ZVlnQ1UxbU0xeEhMZHQ0eGlsRkR0RHMtY2h0ZWtfRDhIczEwMXhOLUhxWWJFYzJJVGJxODZIUVFodEJldW5OYldfY3dhaTM3a3h1OEJuX3QwUQ?oc=5)) have certified their results. Ohio's deadline is near, with questions over some provisional ballots still open, WOUB reports ([WOUB](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxQbzdvNnBpeG1FUkpjNGRfbkVPdXRXRDVaelhxNks5enZ3RzZXcXVweHJrWXB2OThST1FDamxCRXpkeWdyeEZXYnRPWThjWFVXeXh2cW1UOUd4M0NxamJIaF84My04amZIenQwekllMmU1NUlEX1RWaXpVSEkwM2tneEJlNWhPdHNPaDZpWmx5dkszTnltNkNB?oc=5)).
- **Indiana:** a recount in the state Senate Republican leader's close race aims to finish by Dec. 20, the Indiana Capital Chronicle reports ([Indiana Capital Chronicle](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxQbWs4Z3VRNE8tMldKNnNnSkl1dVQ4c2pjM3o3WXA0eTFtb05QQVd1RUhFVHZHZjlNY3pLTzZrTUpCTjhZdFZzQThxd0hOcG1tNWFjV3pzbENqelQzWVAyc2xNNHZneDdmck9PbFpzcUlTV2dmMDFfZnQtdW5RZEVUTmhLUlN0RWpRdWVfeGUxajBwLU5SZE52RTdXMzhOREhhdW5oQ0puaw?oc=5)).

## Legal and federal action
- **California:** an appeals court approved the Justice Department's dismissal of its case over 20,000 California ballots, ending the fight, NBC News reports ([NBC News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxQaGVOdHMxNFhuVDFNSkRXeDdZMXluSTAyVGJzTVVmb011NnZfaUlSTjFqTGg5emNMLWJFd3Q2ZHIzc2JaZ3lDdEstN05feEpSa19TVTdBQkRsNm0wTTRzQWRiVkx4SHhQQUtnbV8zSzhzdFEzTHQ4MkJobjhEaU1ld1RIVGJSbHlxdE9ZZmFCaTlPTnItTHBPaVNDQkxIMnlleGg5VmttdmpfTVBqWV9faV9DSDJYN2wwMDFhOA?oc=5)).
- **Ohio:** the Ohio Democratic Party sued Secretary of State Frank LaRose in federal court on Nov. 23 ([CourtListener](https://www.courtlistener.com/docket/75163266/ohio-democratic-party-v-larose/)). CourtListener shows filings in 24 election-related federal dockets since Nov. 21.

## What voters said
- **Texas and Georgia:** an ABC News analysis finds Democratic enthusiasm among less-frequent voters in both states ([ABC News](https://news.google.?oc=5)), and a separate ABC analysis breaks down Democrats' Georgia sweep ([ABC News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxQTG5KZmlvRkRhV0VER0kwbXZQR0JTOEJyOTA4S2JBYjJEWkVOTlJWbGx5MEFnM015TUJZSHpvY0w4NFJPa2ZCOEtzNVQ3TDZKMGxQamxXR3BFSDk3YWlaXzVDMktZb2VtNHVhSlQzTUMxLXRpUTNUeVZoNmktdnAzc3N2YkRNZVpaUENMNmdVQXVMOVlrdmdVQzdDdVNqMnJRZ0Ixc1hFdFJ6Zw?oc=5)). No new voter-file read from Ralston or Bitzer is in today's leads.

## Coverage note
- **Counting basis:** House calls now follow AP. Races the results table marks won but AP has not called (TN-04, MN-01) are listed as uncalled, and Louisiana's runoff rows are no longer counted as wins. The site shows the same counts.
- **Parser:** the House (435 rows) and Senate (35) tables parsed, and the health check is clean.
- **Court records:** CourtListener used (3 requests; 24 election dockets).
